translator.role_label: Local Operator task subagent (translator record: 'same session as implementer')

audited.en: Team Bridge is on for you
audited.verdict: PASS all locales. 'Team Bridge' kept in Latin, as a statement of fact (est activé / está activado / 已为你开启 / включён / đã được bật / فعال ہے / चालू है), not a question or an offer. Registers: vous / tú / 你 / вы / bạn / آپ / आप, as in the namespace. zh-CN has no space between Latin and CJK, per guide.

audited.en: Your agent can exchange messages with other members' agents in your organization. Nothing was sent when this turned on.
audited.target: Ваш агент может обмениваться сообщениями с агентами других участников вашей организации. При включении ничего не отправлялось.
audited.verdict: PASS all locales. 'agent' per glossary row (agent · agente · 智能体 · агент · tác nhân · ایجنٹ · एजेंट); 'member' per catalogue (membres / miembros / 成员 / участников / thành viên / ارکان / सदस्यों); 'organization' matches ui.teamBridge.scope.label. Second sentence states that nothing was sent when it turned on. No marketing tone, and nothing implies an enable step.
PASS. Byte-identical to ui.agentMessages.settings.action.turn_off in every locale, as the context requires (same verb as Settings).
PASS. The progressive/nominal busy form of the same verb as turn_off; ellipsis is … (zh-CN …… per guide).
PASS. Framed as understanding rather than legal acknowledgement (ce que cela signifie / qué significa esto / 这意味着什么 / что это значит / ý nghĩa / کیا مطلب ہے / क्या मतलब है).
PASS. Standard 'hide details' labels; zh-CN 收起详情 is the idiomatic collapse verb.

PASS. 'Dismiss for good' rather than 'close': Ignorer / Descartar / 忽略 / Скрыть / Ẩn / ہٹائیں / हटाएँ, each matching an existing catalogue dismiss rendering (ui.chat.composer.status.goal_dismiss and peers).

audited.en: The full text is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
audited.target: Полный текст сейчас недоступен. Повторите попытку чуть позже.
audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after B2). Calm; not phrased as an error. zh-CN '再试一次' replaced with guide verb 重试 at 09fc87ace3.

audited.en: Team Bridge could not be turned off. Nothing was changed. Try again.
audited.target: Не удалось отключить Team Bridge. Ничего не изменилось. Повторите попытку.
audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after B2). Says the turn-off failed, that nothing changed, and to retry; never says 'error' or blames the reader. 'Team Bridge' kept Latin; verbs match turn_off in each locale.

audited.en: This notice could not be dismissed. Try again.
audited.target: Не удалось скрыть это уведомление. Повторите попытку.
audited.verdict: PASS (zh-CN after B1/B2). zh-CN used 关闭 (this banner's turn-off verb) for dismiss; fixed to 忽略, matching banner.dismiss, and 重试. Other locales use their banner.dismiss verb (ignorer / descartar / скрыть / ẩn / ہٹائی / हटाई).

independence: Independent auditor (reviewer role). This run wrote none of the audited strings and edited no catalogue byte; remediation commits were authored by a separate translator subagent. This run wrote only this receipt, the per-locale evidence records, and (via ledger-assemble.mjs) the ledger rows.
limitations: No rendered frame, pseudo-localization or RTL layout inspection (this auditor session has no browser tool). ur bidi safety was judged from the strings: no manual controls, plus the render layer's FSI/PDI isolation and dir handling (src/i18n/direction.ts, use-document-direction.ts).
Inherited keys were not re-read (byte identity to already-audited rows).
